question: What warranty do you offer on your safety nets in Chennai for homes?
answer: At GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai, we stand behind the quality and durability of our residential safety net installations. We offer a comprehensive warranty ranging from 3 to 5 years, depending on the specific product and installation requirements. This warranty covers any manufacturing defects in the HDPE material of the net itself, as well as issues arising from faulty installation performed by our trained professionals. Our safety nets are made from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and are UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Chennai climate, ensuring long-lasting protection and peace of mind. The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, or natural disasters.
